heading: Policies entitled to protection and lapse of policies

tree.heading: Determination
tree.text: The Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall determine whether a policy is entitled to protection under this subchapter and shall notify the insured and the insurer of that determination.

tree.heading: Lapse protection
tree.text: A policy that the Secretary determines is entitled to protection under this subchapter shall not lapse or otherwise terminate or be forfeited for the nonpayment of a premium, or interest or indebtedness on a premium, after the date on which the application for protection is received by the Secretary.

tree.heading: Time application
tree.text: The protection provided by this subchapter applies during the insured’s period of military service and for a period of two years thereafter.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 544 of the former Appendix to this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
